name: Doc Rivas
desc: Runs an unlicensed repair bay in Sub-Level 3. Doesn't ask about the damage.

benefit.effect: Part repairs at 25% reduced resource cost

highLoyaltyBenefit.effect: Emergency field repair available once per mission

name: Fen
desc: Information broker. Neon Bazaar sub-level. Moves product and secrets with equal indifference.

benefit.effect: Intel Level 1 costs 0 data_chips (Fen covers it)

highLoyaltyBenefit.effect: Advance warning before DTL increases — 1 cycle heads-up

name: Sgt. Kohl
desc: Precinct 9 veteran. Looks the other way when it costs him nothing. Costs him more than he admits.

benefit.effect: Reduces District Threat Level by 1 once per 3 cycles

highLoyaltyBenefit.effect: Can call off a Taeyang-coordinated patrol event once (consumed)

name: Mira
desc: Rust King adjacent. She moves parts. Nobody asks where they came from. That's the deal.

benefit.effect: Rare part availability windows last 2 extra cycles

highLoyaltyBenefit.effect: One salvage tip per cycle — a part type currently available somewhere in the city

name: Hayashi
desc: Arena matchmaker. Seen a hundred pilots come through those gates. Remembers the ones worth remembering.

highLoyaltyBenefit.effect: Access to a restricted bracket once per prestige run — higher stakes, higher Glory Pool reward

name: Cipher
desc: No face. No address. Only shows up when she has something Taeyang doesn't want you to know.

benefit.effect: Phase 4 mission intel surfaces one objective early

highLoyaltyBenefit.effect: Provides the real objective of Phase 5 missions before entry — full intel free
